headline: 🔴 Iran-linked hackers shut down UK power plant for 4 days, 🛡️ WordPress Pods CVE-2026-19598 CVSS 9.8 affects 100K+ sites, 🔓 Node.js isolated-vm sandbox escape threatens AI agents, 🎯 ShinyHunters claims CyrusOne breach demands $13M, 🚗 Android car head unit botnet campaign widens, 💰 CoinbaseCartel hits 7th victim across 4 countries
summary: Iran-linked hackers forced a UK power plant offline for four consecutive days in the first known Iranian cyberattack on British energy infrastructure, while a critical WordPress Pods flaw and a Node.js sandbox escape exposed over 100,000 sites and AI agent runtimes respectively.
